reviews.text: We are very grateful for your trust in our work, Nel! Your satisfaction is our priority. Anything you need, we are at your service. A hug from the whole family at Our Favorite Pet!

Dear Gustavo, good afternoon! The Nosso Pet Favorito team greatly appreciates your feedback! We hope to continue improving and further increase your level of satisfaction. You are always very welcome at Nosso Pet Favorito!

I've been taking my little Nala to the groomer for almost a year now. It was so difficult to find a pet shop with so much professionalism, love, and care for our pets, and through a friend's recommendation, I found this wonderful pet shop. From the reception to the grooming service, everything is exceptional and incredible. Nala gets her baths from Aunt Andréia, who takes very good care of my princess 🥰.
Dear Marco, thank you so much for your review! You are always very welcome at Our Favorite Pet Shop!!

Today Aunt Karen took care of my baby Nick, she made him look great. Thank you so much for the affection and care. I highly recommend her, she's a great professional, dedicated and very caring.
Thank you so much, I didn't know what to do, where was I going to find someone else to groom him? He's already my loyal groomer, haha. 🥰

I've been a customer of our favorite pet store for years!
The attentive salespeople are always ready to help, and my kittens thank you for the care! 😻 …
Wonderful team. A truly exceptional pet shop. The store is clean, and the staff is very attentive. I couldn't have asked for a better place to pamper my four-legged children.

I'd like to express my satisfaction with the store! I've been a customer for years and the service is always wonderful, the employees are always very friendly and helpful. The grooming service is also wonderful, only competent professionals! My little dog always looks and smells great! The store is always very clean and organized, and the owners are also very friendly and caring with all customers! I'm a loyal customer of the pet shop ❤️

Good afternoon!

Earlier this week I went to the Nosso Pet Favorito store, located at 831 Conde de Bonfim Street in the Tijuca neighborhood, looking for accessories and medications for my dog. Unfortunately, it was impossible to remain in the store, as the smell of incense was unbearable. Even though I'm not familiar with the current health regulations, I believe that an establishment that provides in-person services to animals should not have such a strong smell, since pets have a much more acute sense of smell. It was actually my first visit to the store, as I recently moved to the neighborhood and intended to become a customer through the grooming services they also offer, but unfortunately that won't be possible under these conditions. I would like to know if this is common and permitted by the health authorities. Thank you.

I've been taking my dogs to this pet shop in Tijuca for a while now and I only have praise for it! The service is always very attentive, the professionals are careful and caring with the animals, and the environment is super clean and organized. You can tell they really enjoy what they do and treat the pets with respect and patience. Whenever I need a bath, grooming, or any product, I find everything there, at a fair price and with great kindness. Having a trustworthy pet shop in the neighborhood makes all the difference in everyday life. I wholeheartedly recommend it!
